# Auto-generated rule: prose-presence pin tests: mechanically identifiable (no product import + no spawn + fs-only) and safely deletable in bulk

Test files that import zero product code, spawn no process, and only readFileSync markdown to assert prose presence are structure pins, not tests. The triple filter identifies them mechanically; per-file classification then separates machine contracts (version locksteps, dangling-ref sweeps, placeholder parity - KEEP) from prose pins (DELETE). 43 files/~600 tests/5.7k LOC deleted with the full suite green afterward. One trap: mixed-form files (a real structural guard inside a prose-pin file) need individual reading - the diet missed one such guard (psa-007 wiring), caught by the review panel and ported to validate-plugin.

## Evidence
2026-07-27 I5/I6: 45 deletions, full gate 12599/0 after; MED-7 review finding on psa-007-wiring.test.mjs proves the mixed-form residual risk.
